text:
Nina: Quick postmortem follow-up for the GPU surge incident. We need owners, a dry-run, a 72h soak, and clear rollback triggers. Propose: Carlos -> quota, Jules -> scheduler knobs, Ravi -> soak + dashboards.

Carlos: I can take quota. Need exact CPU/GPU units, node types, and preferred change window.

Jules: Scheduler plan: dry-run first (no quota bump), validate fair-share behavior, then test two knob sets: A) fair_share_weight=0.85 preempt_threshold=0.6, B) fair_share_weight=0.92 preempt_threshold=0.5. Capture scheduler traces.

Ravi: I'll own dashboards and soak. Panels: p95/p99 latency, queue_length, backlog_rate, preempt_rate, eviction_count, scheduling_success. Add alerts for backlog_rate>8% 5m and p99>2s 3m.

Nina: Timeline suggestion: plan doc in 2 business days, dry-run next week, soak 2025-05-07 to 2025-05-10, 24h rollback window after. Agree?

Carlos: Works. I'll draft the quota ticket and include requested units and regional canary (use us-east first).

OpsBot: Created TKT-6651 (gpu-quota) assigned to Carlos, due 2025-05-05.

Jules: Dry-run script for reproducibility:
```
python infra/sim_load.py --qps 900 --dur 2h --model xl --trace scheduler
```

Ravi: I'll schedule daily 20m ops check-ins during soak and attach dashboards to the ticket.

Nina: Rollback criteria: auto-rollback if fair_share_imbalance > 0.15 for 10m OR preempt_rate > 20% for 5m. Rollback steps: revoke quota, revert scheduler config (git revert <hash>), cordon & drain any new nodes. Who runs the rollback? Ops oncall + Carlos for cloud steps.

Carlos: I'll own cloud rollback and escalation to provider support. Add cloud API commands in ticket.

Jules: I'll post config diffs and the exact git hashes and rollback commands before the dry-run. Also enable scheduler.debug during the first hour of each run.

OpsBot: Created TKT-6652 (scheduler-experiments) assigned to Jules, due 2025-05-06.

OpsBot: Created TKT-6653 (gpu-soak-dash) assigned to Ravi, due 2025-05-10.

Ravi: Link placeholder for dashboards: https://internal.grafana/d/gpu-soak. Will add panels and alert rules to TKT-6653.

Nina: Final checklist: Carlos files quota ticket, Jules posts scheduler diffs + dry-run plan, Ravi wires dashboards and check-ins. Reconvene tomorrow 09:00 to confirm tickets and start dry-run.

Carlos: On it.

Jules: Preparing diffs.

Ravi: Calendars sent.

Nina: Thanks team, appreciate the quick turn.
